== Summary ==
Title banner for [[Virtual Block 8]] ("Scoundrels"), from the cover page of the Virtual Block 8.1: Scoundrels PDF. Its cover reads "Official text as of May 11, 2012". The file was created on 18 July 2012.

Source: [https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock8_1.pdf VirtualBlock8_1.pdf], res.starwarsccg.org. Page 1 rendered at 300 dpi, the resolution of the embedded cover image, and cropped to the banner (1954&times;1204 pixels). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261020185537/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock8_1.pdf?copy=2 Internet Archive].

archive.org copy of this exact original (SHA-1 checked by archive.org): [https://archive.org/download/swccg-wiki-images-6/6f/Set-VB8-logo.jpg Internet Archive item].
